verses.1: May those who do evil deeds be punished in the light of day. They will be punished because they have done evil.
verses.2: And they plundered fields and houses, and they raped women. They also sacked the homes of men and women, and their lands were taken away from them.
verses.3: Therefore, the LORD said, “I am considering this family’s misfortune. They will not be able to get out of there. Do not go along with them, for it is a time of trouble.”
verses.4: On that day, a ruler will be placed over you. Then it will be said, “Lord, save us from this situation! It’s the fate of my people. How can I return to my homeland?”
verses.5: Therefore, you shall not tie a rope around your arm in the presence of Jehovah.
verses.6: They shall not be deceived; they will not be tricked. They will not be defeated at all.
verses.7: It is said in the House of Jacob: “The spirit of Jehovah is limited. If these people continue to act in this manner, then His words will not be effective with those who are righteous.”
verses.8: And let my people be freed from the oppression of those who are in charge. May they be freed from those who act as intermediaries during wars.
verses.9: The women of my people will be driven out from their homes. They will be taken away from their homes and sent into exile forever.
verses.10: Get up and go, for this is not the proper way to spend time in Tamah. It’s a waste of time and energy.
verses.11: Let no man walk in deceit and falsehood, like a thief. Let him not seek reward or gain for himself. He should instead serve the people.
verses.12: Let Jacob be gathered together. Let him be united with all of Israel. We will bind him together like sheep in a pen. He will be like a flock of sheep within the words of God. He will be separated from man.
verses.13: The flood rushed towards them. They crossed the gate, and their king went before them. And Jehovah was with them at the head of the army.
